data.headline: Focus
data.text: AI, Artificial intelligence (AI), Computational Intelligence, Advanced Data Storage and Analyses, Machine Learning

data.headline: Target group
data.text: Prospective students in the field of AI, Data Science, Computer Science, and related graduate or undergraduate degrees.

data.headline: Annotation
data.text: Joint degree course with at least 1 mandatory semester in South Bohemia (Ceske Budejovice/Budweis).

data.headline: Area of study
items: Partner institution: University of South Bohemia in Czech Republic (International degree: )

data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
- Bachelor’s academic degree in AI, Data Science, Computer Science or a closely related subject area
- At least 18 ECTS from Artificial intelligence (AI) or Data Science degree programmes
- Successfully passed admission test
- Language requirements
